Game Overview

At its heart, Mini Car Racing is a racing game about dare to craft the ultimate mini vehicle and race through thrilling circuits. Navigate obstacles, show off your driving prowess, and earn bonuses to enhance your ride. Enjoy the creative twist of designing your car while experiencing high-speed fun and excitement. Become the ultimate Mini Car Racer!
